name: PayFlux
summary: Warm-paper fintech app site that opens on a deep green to lime gradient with a hand-held phone, then settles into white data-viz bento cards and a sticky phone walkthrough.

fonts.pairing: tight geometric headline at regular weight, very light text cut (200-300) for body, Fragment Mono uppercase for eyebrow labels

signature: hero gradient that melts from bottle green through lime haze into the paper background, with a hand-held phone and frosted stat chips floating at its sides
sticky phone mockup that swaps screens via scroll-target variants while a numbered list advances beside it
every feature card carries a live-looking micro data viz: dotted world map with arcs, contribution heatmap, stacked transaction toasts, security orbit
imagery: photoreal hand holding a phone, clean UI renders, dotted maps and charts in a single green ramp; blog uses warm candid office photos
layout_grid: 1440 canvas, 32px side gutters (near full-bleed 1376 content), 120px section padding, 2+3 bento and 4-up stat rows, 20px card radius
